wiki.title: Grave Elemental
wiki.text:
Were you look for the pet pal?

The Grave Elemental is an enemy NPC that appears throughout Blackspore Swamp.

Battle
Grave Elementals can be found wandering in Blackspore Swamp. They are featured in the Bone Bog Cemetery. They also feature at Super Spooktacular when the Pumpkin Prince arrives. Sometimes the Pumpkin Prince will spawn a spawner which will spawn hostiles such as Grave Elementals and Necrowart Zombies.

Appearances
Haunted by the Past
Bone Bog Cemetery
Trading Card Game Series 4
